chose: 4.3 part C as built (D39), in two parts.
(1) The PreToolUse rewrite (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) is narrow. One shell segment of cat, head, tail, less or more, whose every operand is a record's plan.md, decisions.md, memory.md or events.jsonl, with no pipe, redirection, substitution or sequencing, becomes `sofar read --session <id> <paths>` in each host's allow-plus-rewrite form. Every other call passes untouched, the Read tool and greps included. SOFAR_READ_GATE=off is the ablation arm.
(2) `sofar read` serves the index view. Decisions in force are one line each (a rule verbatim, else the chose head). Memories are one line each. The plan has its brief one line per paragraph. events.jsonl gets a pointer to `sofar show` and `sofar find`. `--full` prints the file as written. A re-read of an unchanged view in the same session context is one line, through the told set.
over: D39's literal reading, untold fragments in full: the first read of a session has had nothing told, so it returns nearly the whole file, and that opening read is 67% of reads. Rewriting segments inside pipelines and compounds: `cat events.jsonl | grep X` would grep a one-line pointer and break the agent's query.
